source.author: PingYou Ltd
source.method: Paired whole-ring parity return with complete face-and-edge separation ports and joint boundary restoration.
source.attribution_note: PingYou Ltd constructed this finite paired-ring return. The starting triangular array of circumscribed cylinders is standard; no novelty is claimed for cylinder packing and no 2012 optimized lattice is used.

construction.name: finite_paired_whole_ring_complete_port_return
construction.coordinate_convention: Exact canonical U coordinates are native coordinates. Field arrays use the selected real root. Every type1 owner uses the proper half-turn diag(1,-1,-1).

source_control.construction: Alternating complete antiprism owners in triangular circumscribed-cylinder columns. The vertical integer word changes parity; two vertical steps restore the marked ring state.
source_control.integer_tail_rule: Any overlapping pair has centre distance less than2R. Each inverse-row Cauchy bound then forces abs(word_i)<bound_i. Every residual word for both source parities is checked exactly.
source_control.source_attribution: Standard triangular cylinder arrangement; new alternating marked whole-ring finite return. No optimized published source lattice is used.

complete_pair_palette_control.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.
complete_pair_palette_control.scope: Two fixed proper antiprism frames only; no arbitrary-frame recognition or packing optimum claim.

construction.physical_operation: Retain whole-owner parity, source words and both proper frames. Jointly restore every directed host wall and pair separator. The new pair ports hold simultaneously at the saved exact predecessor.
construction.wall_rule: a dot c_i + h_type_i(a) <= s h_host(a)
construction.native_clearance: Dilate exact centres by1+1/500000 and set scale to(1+1/500000)*exact_nominal+1/500000.
construction.new_configuration_check: Sorted centered squared radii differ from both the retained source words and selected public baseline.

contribution.method: Complete fixed-frame antiprism returns use actual typed pair contacts, including edge-edge supports. Pentagonal-prism constructions use whole-height products of the published pentagon double lattice and complete finite patch compositions, with the source authors retained. All native witnesses, source and parent decoders, finite boundary costs, independent reviews, current public comparisons, and passing float/exact checks are included. All 32 strictly improve occupied configurations and are distinct from earlier fresh batches. Finite construction credit: PingYou Ltd.
